items.title: Call to Order
notes: Mayor Watters welcomed everyone and called the meeting to order.

items.title: Land Acknowledgement
notes: Councillor Lustgarten-Evoy read the Land Acknowledgement.

items.title: Addendums and Corrections to the Agenda
notes: There were no addendums or corrections to the agenda.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest Under the Municipal Conflict of Interest
notes: Act
None.

items.title: Introduction of Artist - Terry Golletz
notes: Barb Lee on behalf of the Elora Fergus Arts Council introduced Terry Golletz, a local artist with over 40 years of experience, including art shows in Paris and New York.

items.title: Wellington Federation of Agriculture - Janet Harrop
notes: Re: Agri-Food System Study

Following the playing of a short video, Janet Harrop, Past President, distributed hard copies of the Agri-Food System Study and provided an overview of the key findings. She indicated Wellington County accounts for 5.8% of Ontario’s agri-food value chain and covers 0.2% of Ontario’s Land Base.
Councillor Lustgarten-Evoy indicated when appropriate, she would like to put forward a motion.
Councillor Wilton then declared a conflict of pecuniary interest as her consulting firm authored the report and left the meeting.
Mayor Watters expressed the importance of Centre Wellington and the County of Wellington and the role we all play in local and regional food security as well as balancing the need for housing.

items.title: Councillor Wilton rejoined the meeting.
notes: County Council Report - Councillor Steve O'Neill, County Ward 4 Councillor Steve O'Neill, County Ward 4 provided an update on the impending changes to the recycling program at the County of Wellington and responded to questions.

items.title: Councillor's Committee Updates
notes: Members of Council provided updates to the ongoing activities of the advisory committees.

items.title: Rich Wigmore & Cassie Silverthorne, Elora Rocks Hockey Club
notes: re: item 8.1 The Elora Rocks Hockey Club Interest Free Loan Rich Wigmore and Cassie Silverthorne provided an overview of the high operational costs and inherited debt of the Elora Rocks and requested the Township consider forgiving the debt.

R. Wigmore and staff responded to questions regarding the history of team management, the impact of COVID and the Jefferson Elora Community Centre renovations, potential refinancing options, and the composition of the team.

items.title: Consent Items
notes: Consent Agenda Items are considered routine in nature and are voted on collectively. However, any Member of Council may request one or more items be removed from the Consent Agenda for separate discussion and/or action.
Staff responded to questions and provided clarification pertaining to Items 7.3, 7.4 and 7.6.
Mayor Watters called for a 5 minute recess, the meeting reconvened at 7:33pm.

items.title: The Elora Rocks Hockey Club Interest Free Loan
notes: Report from M. Tucker, Manager of Facilities Operations M. Tucker, Manager of Facilities Operations provided an overview of the report, indicating the Elora Rocks Hockey Club has shared with staff their challenges to pay ice rentals annually each season and the payments associated with an interest free loan of $25,149.20. He explained staff has provided two options for Council’s consideration, one of which includes the club’s request to forgive their past debt and allow them to focus on success moving forward.
Staff and R. Wigmore responded to questions regarding the current and past structure of the hockey club, potential community grants available, and the requirement for payment prior to ice allocation.
After discussion, the following was put forward:

items.title: RFP#21-24 Short Term Rental Accommodation
notes: Report from S. Lloyd-Smith, Manager of Purchasing and Risk Management
A. McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer provided an overview of the report.
Staff responded to questions regarding the public consultation process, the source of funding for the project, and coordination of efforts with the Tourism strategy.

items.title: Spring 2024 Red Tape Reduction Package & Draft Provincial Planning
notes: Statement
Report from B. Salmon, Managing Director of Planning and Development

B. Salmon, Managing Director of Planning and Development provided an overview of the report, indicating the purpose of the report is to advise Council of the consultation process and to provide preliminary comments. He indicated staff is also seeking Council’s endorsement for staff to submit comments to the Ministry on behalf of the Township.

B. Salmon responded to questions regarding consideration for more assertive countryside line policies, similar to those of the Region of Waterloo, and the potential reduction in minor variance applications.

motions.item_title: Wellington Federation of Agriculture - Janet Harrop
motions.text: THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington receive the Wellington Federation of Agriculture’s Agri-Food Systems Study which underscores the distinct economic, environmental, and social significance of farmland in Centre Wellington for information; AND THAT staff refer to the study during the development of policies and strategies aimed at cultivating sustainable land use and farmland preservation throughout the municipality. Councillors Lustgarten-Evoy and Adams agreed to withdraw the motion to provide an opportunity for additional public consultation.
